needs_aria.surface_label: GET /browse — GCS bucket browser HTML page
aria_concerns: Directory listing table lacks column headers with scope attributes
Navigation breadcrumbs not wrapped in <nav aria-label>
File/folder type distinction communicated visually only

needs_aria.surface_label: GET /image/{key} — image asset HTML viewer page
aria_concerns: Displayed image needs descriptive alt text (not just the filename)
Back/navigation link needs clear accessible label
SVG images embedded inline should carry <title> and <desc> elements

needs_aria.surface_label: GET /view/{key} — Markdown article HTML viewer page
aria_concerns: Breadcrumb navigation should use <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> and aria-current='page' on the last item
Rendered Markdown heading hierarchy should be validated (no skipped levels)
Code blocks should be marked with role='region' or appropriate landmark if long

needs_aria.surface_label: GET / — question viewer HTML root page
aria_concerns: Math question content rendered as SVG needs accessible description for screen readers
Answer choice list should use <ol> or <ul> with role='radiogroup' if interactive
Any LaTeX/MathML rendered inline should carry aria-label or be wrapped in a <span> with descriptive text

needs_aria.surface_label: GET / — question bank fetcher HTML index page
aria_concerns: Topic group headings should use semantic heading elements (h2/h3) not styled divs
Links to topic pages need descriptive text beyond just the slug

needs_aria.surface_label: GET /topic/{slug} — question bank fetcher topic HTML detail page
aria_concerns: Question items in the list need semantic list markup
Mathematical expressions rendered as images need alt text
PDF download link should indicate file type and size in accessible label
